releaseNotes: Smarter matching: weak matches are auto-retried (incl. cross-camera) before the sync finishes, and anything still weak/unmatched is parked at the end in chronological order instead of being placed wrong. Silent clips (no audio) are skipped. Exact-duplicate clips (same content, different filename) sync once; copies parked. Live estimated time remaining during sync. New setting 'Keep computer awake while syncing' (on by default). Proxy toggle moved back to Settings.
